flag_rules.name: BACKFILLED
flag_rules.rationale: Backfill provenance must be adjudicated prospectively before Gate-1 counting.

flag_rules.name: CLOCK_SKEW
flag_rules.rationale: A bar containing a receipt timestamp before event time is a causal data defect.

flag_rules.name: CROSSED_QUOTE
flag_rules.rationale: Crossed quotes are excluded from Mid aggregation and count as causal defects.

flag_rules.name: GAP
flag_rules.rationale: A calendar-confirmed unexpected liquid-hours gap counts as a causal defect.

flag_rules.name: GAP_CALENDAR_UNKNOWN
flag_rules.rationale: An unclassified gap cannot be counted or cleared before calendar review.

flag_rules.name: LOCKED_QUOTE
flag_rules.rationale: Locked quotes are excluded from Mid aggregation and count as causal defects.

flag_rules.name: NONPOSITIVE_ASK
flag_rules.rationale: A nonpositive ask is an invalid causal quote.

flag_rules.name: NONPOSITIVE_BID
flag_rules.rationale: A nonpositive bid is an invalid causal quote.

flag_rules.name: OUT_OF_SESSION
flag_rules.rationale: Out-of-session evidence must remain visible and counts as a causal defect.

flag_rules.name: QUALITY_WARMUP
flag_rules.rationale: Rolling-history warmup treatment requires prospective human agreement.

flag_rules.name: SPREAD_OUTLIER
flag_rules.rationale: The configured causal spread diagnostic counts when present in liquid hours.

flag_rules.name: TIME_REGRESSION
flag_rules.rationale: A source-time regression is a causal ordering defect.

flag_rules.name: TS_RECV_IMPUTED
flag_rules.rationale: Historical receipt imputation is provenance, not silently clean or defective.

flag_rules.name: PRICE_OUTLIER
flag_rules.rationale: Future-confirmed reversion is QA-only and needs an explicit counting decision.
